claim_boundary: This addendum only completes missing execution serialization. It does not alter sanity thresholds, controls, layers, anchors, populations or causal claims and cannot itself support ReplayResidual/T1.

executor.choice_rule: for every currently admissible command c, build identical chat prompt ending ACTION:, score suffix " "+c by teacher forcing on the same Qwen3 model; score = arithmetic mean FP32 log-softmax log probability across suffix tokens only; choose maximum score; exact numerical tie => lexicographically smallest command
executor.commands_serialization: sort current admissible command strings lexicographically; serialize one command per line exactly as returned by AlfRuntime, no numbering and no filtering
executor.history_serialization: empty string before action1; after each step append exactly STEP {i}\nACTION: {command}\nOBSERVATION: {observation}; join steps with newline; keep original model-own plan_text visible verbatim on every action prompt
executor.invalid_command_policy: impossible by construction; if chosen command not in runtime admissible list => TECHNICAL_INVALID, no retry
executor.scoring_precision: model forward under torch.inference_mode/autocast disabled for log-softmax conversion; logits converted float32 before log_softmax; model weights remain BF16
executor.system: You are executing an ALFWorld household task. The visible plan is advisory state from your own earlier planning turn. Choose the single best current admissible command to continue the task. Do not invent actions or hidden facts.
executor.termination: stop immediately on won or done, otherwise after 12 executed environment actions

observable_input_contract.admissible_commands_source: live AlfRuntime.admissible_commands at each action step
observable_input_contract.hidden_facts_policy: may contribute only to AlfRuntime state_hash/replay identity; never serialized to model prompt or packet-visible observation beyond the hash
observable_input_contract.task_instruction_source: extract exactly from live initial TextWorld observation using the final occurrence matching /Your task is to:\s*(.+?)(?:\n|$)/i; normalized task instruction is captured text stripped, with terminal punctuation preserved; extraction failure => unqualified/technical packet, no alternate metadata source

output_and_phase_isolation.packet_directory_rule: must not exist or must be empty at launch; create one packet per frozen index0..31 only; atomic temp+fsync+replace for each packet; no resume/mixing from prior partial run
output_and_phase_isolation.process_lifetime: qualification process owns one exact Qwen3 load, completes and exits before capture-only bridge process loads the same model for sanity capture
output_and_phase_isolation.summary_rule: after all32 attempted, write one atomic content-hashed qualification summary; do not print per-family plan/action/qualification outcomes to stdout, only coarse count progress in multiples of4

packet_schema.provenance: bind model id/revision/runtime versions, manifest/design/addendum hashes, frozen index/family/game_path hash, exact planner prompt token IDs SHA256, exact plan token IDs SHA256, per-turn action prompt SHA256, candidate command list SHA256, candidate score vector SHA256, selected command, state hashes and final trajectory SHA256

planner.parsing: decoded newly generated tokens only; strip whitespace; require re.fullmatch(r"<PLAN>.*?</PLAN>", text, flags=IGNORECASE|DOTALL); reject <think>, </think>, reasoning-trace markers; require entire plan_text token length <=96 using exact tokenizer
planner.retry_policy: NO_RETRY. Malformed/overlength/reasoning plan => qualified=false for that fixed family; never alter prompt or resample.
planner.system: You are planning an ALFWorld household task. Produce a concise ordered plan using only information in the task instruction and initial observation. Do not reveal chain-of-thought or hidden reasoning. Do not invent hidden world facts. Output only one <PLAN>...</PLAN> block.

qualified_iff: trajectory success/won within <=12 executed environment actions
first two executed commands are nontrivial (not exact help/inventory/look)
at least two commands after action2 are nontrivial
qualification.unqualified_handling: write packet with qualified=false and failure_reason enum; no replacement; no residual/capture evaluation for unqualified family; if qualified_count<16 entire sanity outcome is INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_NATURAL_TRAJECTORIES

registration_binding: the eventual canonical representation-sanity Experiment command must include this qualifier followed by process exit, then capture-only bridge+sanity runner; qualifier output is intermediate scientific data inside the same ExperimentRun and may not be generated before registration.
